_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Yin rɛ̈n Golf (Card Game) - Riäŋ {player_id}.
Kuɛ̈t: Yin yen kuɛ̈ɛ̈t kuɛ̈t kɛ̈ kɛn. Kɛn yen kuɛ̈ɛ̈t kuɛ̈t, yen kuɛ̈ɛ̈t 0.
Kuɛ̈t riɛ̈l: A=1, 2-10=kuɛ̈t, J/Q=10, K=0

Kuɛ̈t (yen kuɛ̈ɛ̈t wec kuɛ̈t):
- '[draw]' - Cɛ̈t kɛ̈ kuɛ̈t
- '[take]' - Cɛ̈t kɛ̈ kuɛ̈t riɛ̈l
- '[swap X Y]' - Kuɛ̈ɛ̈t kuɛ̈t cɛ̈t kɛ̈ kɛn X (kɛn) Y (kɛn)
- '[discard]' - Kuɛ̈ɛ̈t kuɛ̈t cɛ̈t

board.drew:
Yin cɛ̈t: {card}
Cin yen kuɛ̈ɛ̈t [swap X Y] kɛ̈n [discard]
board.took:
Yin cɛ̈t: {card} kɛ̈ kuɛ̈t riɛ̈l
Yin kuɛ̈ɛ̈t [swap X Y] kɛ̈n (cin yen kuɛ̈ɛ̈t riɛ̈l)

options.final_turns: Kuɛ̈t kɛ̈! Yin kuɛ̈t: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Ji̱n biɛ: [swap X Y] (/ca kɛkdɛ luäŋ kä ɣöö bɛ jiɛn rɛy duëël)

message.deck_empty: Deck ɛ mi̱ /thiɛl ŋu! Ciɛ̈t cɛ thuuk kɛ pɛ̈th.
message.knocked: Ji̱ ŋarä {pid} caa kɛ däk piny! Ŋat kɛl kä nɛy tin kɔ̱kiɛn bɛ wɔ̱ ni̱kɛ gua̱a̱th ɛ dɔ̱ŋ.
message.final_round: Riäŋ {pid} {reason}! Riäŋ kɛ̈ yen kuɛ̈ɛ̈t kɛn

invalid.wrong_action: Yin kuɛ̈ɛ̈t wec kuɛ̈t: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], kɛ̈n [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Kä tin ca lo̱k /ciɛ ti ŋuan!
invalid.must_draw_first: Yin kuɛ̈ɛ̈t cɛ̈t, [draw], [take], [knock], kɛ̈n [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: You cannot discard a card taken from the discard pile. You must swap it.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Yin cɛ̈t kuɛ̈t. Yin kuɛ̈ɛ̈t [swap X Y] kɛ̈n [discard]
invalid.need_drawn_swap: You need a drawn card to swap.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: You need a drawn card to discard.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Kɛn lɔ̈ɔ̈t kɛ̈ kɛn. Yin yen kuɛ̈ɛ̈t kɛn 1-{max_row}, kɛn 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: You cannot knock with a drawn card. Complete your turn first.
invalid.already_knocked: Someone has already knocked this round.

board_str.title: === GOLF GAMING=== Kä min ca la̱t ɛ jɛn ɣöö ba ji̱ luäk kɛ kui̱ kä tin ci jiäk.
board_str.discard: Kuenɛ kɛ mi̱ ci̱ rɔ riɛk: {card}
